scope: Read-only official source and installed-header contract review; no native queue implementation, build, GPU execution or measured speed claim.

source_findings.fact: Generic queues use QueueGroup[Compute].ZeOrdinal. computeIndex selects an index within the compute group, not a copy-only group.
Native creation accepts immediate command lists, validates zeCommandListIsImmediate, and respects isNativeHandleOwned. Native in-order construction receives the original immediate list.
The native-list constructor passes the supplied list into commandListManager rather than requesting a new compute ordinal.
make_queue tests the native handle variant, passes immediate/list identity, native device, ownership and properties to make_queue_impl.

documentation.fact: UR_L0_V2_FORCE_DISABLE_COPY_OFFLOAD=1 keeps copies on the engine behind their original queue. The flag alone does not prove every queue uses a compute engine.
L0v2 native make_queue requires an in-order immediate command list. Out-of-order native make_queue is undefined behavior.

partial_actual_API_observation.scope: Only first15000 startup log lines read, not the whole model trace.
partial_actual_API_observation.queue_identity: Default initial queues only; the dedicated expert-copy queue has not been mapped.
partial_actual_API_observation.does_not_prove: All expert transfers use render/compute engine, transfer dominance or PCIe overlap.

before_any_candidate_GPU_use: Determine installed UR source identity; do not equate current upstream code to the installed adapter.
Identify the actual expert-copy queue and enumerate a copy-only queue group without assuming an ordinal or queue index.

Verify counter-event cross-engine waits, barrier support, error-path ownership and native handle lifetime with the installed runtime. Native ownership must survive references held by outstanding events.

Keep the qualified offload-disabled runtime and engine unchanged throughout current full and quiet tests. First use of any later candidate needs logged exact-word health and a bounded owned diagnostic numerical gate.
